relationships.subject: CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: Preventive medications like topiramate, onabotulinumtoxinA, and calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) monoclonal antibodies improve chronic migraine with MOH regardless of withdrawal.

key_findings: Preventive therapies including CGRP mAbs improve chronic migraine with MOH regardless of withdrawal.
NDPH has no treatment guidelines; options include CGRP mAbs, onabotulinumtoxinA and others.
